content_text:
Hello everyone,
I want to recreat the old flash look we used for photography  from the last century.
You can see the effect I want to achieve here in the first 15 secondes
https://youtu.be/zdkRdVPzam8?si=wN3WRU1mjk-MD_WV
or here
https://youtu.be/X2D3zFF3xWg?si=1zDgX3x-k1wPqOxr
My thought was using an halogen bulb fixture with the flash effect on a dimmer but I’m not sure about the graduation and the fall of of the effect.
Then I don’t know which type of light to use, fresnel ? Open face ? Just a bulb ? Or maybe just rent real flash but I’m shooting with film and I don’t want and I can’t go over more than 64 Fps.
You can see bellow maybe the light they was using on the second video.
Thank you !
